we developed a fusion protein consisting in the extracellular domain (ectodomain) of human tissue factor (tTF) and the GNGRAHA peptide (NGR).

the use of tissue factor (TF) as an antitumor agent.
the development of novel targeted thrombogenic agents for the treatment of solid tumors.
the development of a new therapeutic concept for tumor therapy.

the targeted coagulation system, which has already been successfully applied to treat thrombosis in patients with deep vein thrombosis, may also be used to target and occlude tumor vessels.

the targeted fusion protein tTF/NGR is a safe and effective drug for inducing thrombosis in tumor vessels.
